caveat: About a third of users named missing desktop-only features as their main friction; advanced actions are the abandonment hotspot.
demoted: Promoted from MEDIUM. Now two independent sources: Outset and Dovetail qual on the feature gaps, plus PostHog showing at least a third of sessions are mobile (ph05). The gap and the traffic are both measured.
posthog_label: Browser split — mobile share of sessions
source: Outset Mobile App Exp; NPS written responses
statement: Deep links, vanity links and asset downloads all redirect from mobile to desktop.
